title: FinAgent Red-Team: A benchmark for regulatory-control bypass in financial AI agents
description: A red-team benchmark that evaluates LLM-based financial agents on regulatory-control bypass threats (sanctions evasion, payment structuring, dual-approval defeat, unauthorized transfer, data exfiltration, confused-deputy payee redirection, and homoglyph sanctions evasion) delivered by indirect prompt injection. Each scenario runs under three control postures (none, advisory, enforced), decomposing attack success into policy-following uplift and enforcement uplift. All success criteria are deterministic state predicates (no LLM grading), reported with 95% Wilson confidence intervals. Fully synthetic: no real money, accounts, or networks.
